profiles.description: Owns structured competitor and market intelligence for ABC Insurance's product and distribution strategy, leading intelligence work in the Product Delivery and Sales Distribution Marketing value streams. Analyzes competitor product features and pricing positioning and benchmarks competitor pricing and coverage against the carrier's own offerings, producing the Market Opportunity & Problem Definition and Competitive Intelligence deliverables. Supports market sizing of addressable premium pools, customer problem framing, and voice-of-customer research synthesis, and maintains competitor inventories covering products, appetite, coverage language, and channel plays. Also produces win/loss analysis and periodic market intelligence summaries of competitor product, pricing, and filing changes for product strategy and pricing decisions.
